rows.notes: [SC198] 2025 concentrate output 16,421 t (94-96% TGC) from ~170 kt dry ore processed, per the mine's director (Tanzania Daily News 2026-06-01; 'last year' = 2025). It replaces the 2024 figure 38,140 t, which was USGS-reported exports, not output. Sales orders >27,800 t were also stated (not recorded). Quote came through the fetch tool's 125-character excerpt, not a full-page read. GAP: USGS MCS 2026 gives Tanzania 75 kt for 2025e, i.e. 4.6x this mine's output; no second producer with a figure was found (a minister statement of 25,000 t from two mines, Lindi Jumbo and God Mwanga, is undated). Likely USGS counts exports/stockpile sales; unresolved.

[SC198] Northern Graphite 2025 year-end release (2026-05-01): concentrate production 5,938 t in 2025 (2024: 11,697 t); sales 8,780 t of concentrate sold (-29%), so sales exceeded production by drawing inventory; quarterly production reported 1,211 t (Q1), 2,142 t (Q2), 2,325 t (Q3), Q4 not separately read. The release says the mine and plant were temporarily placed on care and maintenance after Q4 overburden stripping, with mining to resume around end-June 2026. USGS Canada 2025e 8 kt is closer to 2025 sales (8.8 kt) than to production (5.9 kt).

[SC198] Total Graphite plc (formerly Tirupati) final results for the year ended 31 March 2026: Group production 2,964 t (FY ended 31 Mar 2025: 2,169 t). Group figure = Vatomina essentially (Sahamamy has been on care and maintenance since 2024). production_year 2026 = fiscal year Apr 2025-Mar 2026 (D-104: nine of twelve months fall in 2025). Search results also say operations were paused Sep 2025 to Mar 2026 for equipment installation, restarted end-March 2026, then suspended again in July 2026 with a restart above 1,000 t/month targeted for December 2026 (Mining Weekly/Engineering News 2026-07-17, snippets only; project_state not changed here).
